requirements.text: Users should be able to color-code classes in the timetable
Users should be able to hide cancelled classes in the timetable
Users should be able to add study blocks to their timetables
Students should receive notifications via email when grades are posted
Students should receive notifications within the portal when grades are posted
Students should be able to provide feedback on the quality of module content
Students should be able to provide feedback on the instructors' teaching effectiveness
Students should be able to provide feedback on the resources provided for the modules
The enhancements should prioritize ease of use
The enhancements must integrate with the existing portal infrastructure without causing complications
